scope: One official ILSP candidate; access/license/native-format metadata only. No weights or weight ranges, tokenizer vocabulary, model construction, inference, resource measurement, production change or unused validation access.

candidate.hash_provenance: Published Hugging Face LFS object identity, not an independently downloaded weight hash.
candidate.family: Llama 3.1-derived Greek/English instruction model; distinct from previously tested Qwen/Gemma/HyMT/Marian/M2M families.

access.notes: Both official base and GGUF repositories report private:false and gated:false. No token or account agreement was needed for the small-file reads. This is public access evidence, not a completed multi-gigabyte transfer.

Distributed derivative models have a Llama naming condition. Applicable law and the incorporated acceptable-use policy apply. Public access does not make this Apache/MIT or remove these obligations.
license.legal_scope: Source-term inventory for feasibility, not a product-specific legal opinion.

revision_conclusion: The 2026 base repository revision is documentation-only relative to its 2025-10-29 state. All published model shard identities and runtime/config/tokenizer identities match the February 9 model upload that predates the official Q4 upload. The Q4 LFS object itself is unchanged since first upload. This resolves the newer-README ambiguity; quantization was not numerically reproduced.

native_format.template_scope_caveat: Repository-level GGUF metadata currently reports totalFileSize of the Q3 file. It establishes the publisher’s native template; the chosen Q4 embedded header/template was not fetched or independently inspected. A future authorized import must bind its actual embedded template and runtime rendering before output.
native_format.published_template: Llama 3.1 Jinja with BOS, system/user/assistant headers, end-of-turn markers, fixed default date and system framing. Production system/user text can be checked against this native renderer without inventing a prompt.
native_format.publisher_system_description: Greek helpful-assistant persona; requests the same language as user unless otherwise instructed.
future_setup_requirements: Use the immutable official Q4 file and verify full LFS hash only if download is separately authorized.
Explicitly freeze context 4096 and temperature 0 rather than inherit publisher context 131072 or sampling defaults.
Verify the effective native prompt contains the intended production system/user messages; bind any imported system and stop layers.
Measure a single owned process group under the existing 6 GiB/4-CPU limits; weight size alone is not process RAM or speed evidence.
Keep original source/criteria and rejection rules unchanged; no quality promotion from metadata.
